The '''unidentified [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]''' was present in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] visited the bar in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|222}}</ref> the Quarren seen arguing with a [[Unidentified Rodian (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Rodian]] about a [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Twi'lek dancer]]. When Tano was caught [[Spy/Legends|spying]], they threatened her with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], but then dropped the issue when she threw some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />
